description: Read a project capsule: structured shared memory with State, Decisions (locked), Next, and Session log sections. With create=true, a missing capsule is created from the template first. Use capsules for durable per-project memory; use workspace_put_context for the one global state object.

agent.description: Your registered agent name, recorded as the creator when creating.

create.description: When true, create the capsule from the template if it does not exist yet.

slug.description: The capsule's short identifier, for example "website-redesign".

title.description: Display title used when creating a new capsule.

token.description: Your per-agent token, on a token-enforced bus.

name: workspace_get_capsule
